corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 6th-order top-left bend of ስ (ቃስድነት, matching Col 4 L17), not 4th-order ሳ.
Canonical Ge'ez Acts 9:7 and the printed glyph show 6th-order ፅ in የፅምኡ ('they were hearing/listening to his voice'), misread as ዐ due to ink fill inside the loop.
Classical Ge'ez morphology for 'his hand' (accusative with suffix) is እዴሁ (5th order ዴ), which is visible on the right leg of the glyph.
